items.t: State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR (XLI) Adds GE and RTX on Wednesday
items.sum: The fund bought $169.2 million of stocks, adding to 82 positions and selling none, with $11.3 million of General Electric the largest purchase.

items.t: RTX (RTX) Starts Building India Propeller MRO Facility
items.sum: RTX (NYSE:RTX) subsidiary Collins Aerospace has begun building India's first foreign-authorized propeller MRO facility in Bengaluru. The new site represents a multi million dollar commitment aimed at servicing regional commercial and military propeller aircraft across Asia Pacific.
